rows: theme (dark, contrast), editable, font (the listing's own size), focus (the module it shows)
{type: "set", preamble, modules, tail}: a module's listing gets the whole program; the preamble's listing, the preamble alone
size (its code's height, for the page to size the frame), status (errors, holes)
the new program to every other listing of it
Go to definition, found in the listing
{type: "caret", top}: where the caret went, for the page to scroll there
{type: "reveal", name} to the listing that defines the name
{type: "goto", name}: the name under the caret, such as Geometry.area, then caret from the listing that shows it
the listing's earlier or later text, as set
{type: "history", redo}: the page keeps each listing's history
